Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football Debibi United stun Hearts to end Phobians winning streak Source : Victor Atsu Tamakloe 1 November 2026 10:55pm Audio By Carbonatix
Hearts of Oak’s three-match winning streak came to an end after a 1-0 defeat to Debibi United at Debibi Presby Park
.Sarkodie Demetrous’s effort in the 51st minute handed the debutants a their first topflight.
Victory brings reprieve for the time being, lifting them out of the relegation zone for the first time this season.
The Phobians, meanwhile, have dropped to third on the league table.
